BEHIND THE MATCH

A little shinobi.
A lot of you.

This is a playful interpretation of your working habits, not a psychological assessment or an official Naruto quiz.

Twelve scenarios build a profile across analysis, practice, experimentation, collaboration, persistence, independence and risk control. We compare it with 22 editorial character profiles. Close results are shown as close calls, not precise percentages.

Character connections draw on the original story, including the characters’ growth. Your answers stay in this browser. Shared links contain only the character, never your answers.
